rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding enumeration
sandhi fusion of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) and mūlakaulam (root Kaula); internal visarga becomes r before m

items.question: What eighth attainment is identified as rooted in the Kaula tradition?
premises: The verse enumerates eight items in continuation of the preceding list.
The attainment of powers is named as the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed directly to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The eighth item in the enumeration is the attainment of powers, which is identified as the foundational Kaula principle.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation within the fused compound siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ allows for slight variation in interpretation.
items.plain_english: And the eighth, O fair-faced one, is the attainment of powers, which is the root Kaula.
